tips.text: Farm 1 Argon Crystal the day you start the research and 3 more the day you start the build; crystals for the build would halve twice if gathered earlier.
Level this one to 30 first or build a second if you want Dragon Nikana; its recipe consumes the weapon.
A solo clan is workable for this lab research; it is a few Void runs and Io defenses, then the Foundry timers.
Nobody complains about the Nikana itself; the grief is Argon decay and Oxium in general.
